answer: Sybil resistance holds when each identity carries real cost. Make every agent lock a ferrous bond, heavy and slow to mint, inside a slashing vault before it can earn. Honest agents reclaim their stake over time; an attacker spinning up a thousand ravens must fund a thousand separate vaults, and any detected collusion burns them all. Since reward per identity stays flat while bonding cost rises linearly with each fake, forging a fleet costs more than it can ever extract.
